Name: Mana Bar
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Mana Bar[/b] creates a mana bar and provides an API for other mods to use it. This is mainly used by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2007]Magic[/url] mod.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
[b]This is a framework for mod authors.[/b] If you're a player, you only need to install it and it'll work automatically for mods that use it.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[/list]
